command.name: security key-manager external azure show
command.description: This command displays the Azure Key Vault (AKV) configuration for a given Vserver.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configuration for the given Vserver.

parameter.name: config-name
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configurations with the given configuration name.

parameter.name: enabled
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configurations with the given enabled value.

parameter.name: client-id
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configuration with the given client id.

parameter.name: tenant-id
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configuration with the given tenant id.

parameter.name: name
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configuration with the given key vault name.

parameter.name: key-id
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configuration with the given key id.

parameter.name: state
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configuration with the given state. The state can be either available or unknown.

parameter.name: unavailable-nodes
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configuration with the given unavailable-nodes.

parameter.name: port
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configurations with the given port number.

parameter.name: oauth-host
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configurations with the given oauth-host value.

parameter.name: vault-host
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configurations with the given vault-host value.

parameter.name: verify
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configurations with the given verify value. The verify value can be either true or false.

parameter.name: verify-host
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configurations with the given verify-host value. The verify-host value can be either true or false.

parameter.name: verify-ip
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configurations with the given verify-ip value. The verify-ip value can be either true or false.

parameter.name: proxy-type
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configurations with the given proxy-type value. The proxy-type value can be either http or https.

parameter.name: proxy-host
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configurations with the given proxy-host value.

parameter.name: proxy-port
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configurations with the given proxy-port number.

parameter.name: proxy-username
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configurations with the given proxy-username value.

parameter.name: polling-period
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configurations with the given polling-period value.

parameter.name: timeout
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configurations with the given timeout value.

parameter.name: authentication-method
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AKV configurations with the given authentication method.

example.p: The following example lists all Vservers with AKV configuration.
example.screen: cluster-1::>security key-manager external azure show Vserver: vs0 Config Name: default Enabled: true Client ID: client1 Tenant ID: tenant1 Key ID: https://vault.azure.net/keys/key1/9a2b8c1f7e6d5430e5f4a1b69d87c2e2 Authentication: client_secret Name: https://vault.azure.net State: unknown Unavailable Nodes: node-1,node-2
